objective: Move the owner-facing Perception/Screen Capture dashboard workflow out of the legacy App.vue root into a dedicated typed Vue page while preserving the existing explicit-capture, opaque-grant, Vision-key and TTL boundaries.
non_goals: Do not change capture authorization, source-grant lifetime, image persistence, OCR/VLM provider behavior, Cloud key storage, model selection rules, or scheduler/VRAM admission.
Do not add a dependency, new capture mode, automatic capture, background capture, raw source ID exposure, or real model/Cloud/runtime testing against the owner's active desktop.
Do not migrate unrelated Speech, Resources, Avatar, Live2D or Runtime pages in this slice.
contracts: PerceptionPage is presentation and owner-interaction only: it receives bounded, typed view data and emits intent or v-model updates. It does not import Electron, Node, direct network APIs, persistence or model runtimes.
App.vue remains the sole owner of typed window.hinaDesktop calls, chat-session binding, opaque capture grants, Safety control, Vision configuration, error logging and state lifecycle.

The page never receives a raw desktop source ID, API key from persistence, hidden model text, raw pixel buffer or secret. Source tokens and preview data remain bounded renderer data supplied by existing typed IPC.
Capture stays explicit owner-click only; the feature flag, 60-second single-use grant, full-frame downscale choices, OCR/VLM opt-in and 15-second observation semantics remain unchanged.
Desktop renderer security tests include the extracted page and prove no direct renderer network/Electron/storage capability was introduced.
allowed_dependencies: Existing Vue 3/TypeScript, current Electron typed IPC and repository test tooling; no new dependency.
acceptance_criteria: All Perception page markup is removed from App.vue and rendered through pages/PerceptionPage.vue.
The extracted page retains source selection, resolution/label/OCR/VLM option bindings, Vision provider/model controls, result/error/timing display and Ask-Hina intent without direct runtime access.
Dashboard module documentation records PerceptionPage as extracted and names the remaining legacy pages accurately.
Desktop typecheck, desktop security/build test and the repository fast gate pass without generated test artifacts retained.
